name: Sage
title: Soft serifs. A measured pace.
label: #b8bea7
note: A softly drawn serif gives the date rail and event names one voice. Muted sage connects the category, price and outlined action without turning any of them into a bright block.
spacing: 24px shared edges, 24px card padding and a 20px pause before time and price.

name: Bookish
title: A finer, quieter stroke.
label: #babeaa
note: Lora brings a more calligraphic edge to the same composition. Slightly smaller title sizes and an unhurried line height keep that detail from making the cards feel busy.
spacing: The 24px inset and card rhythm stay fixed; optical type size supplies the difference.

name: Soft Margin
title: More space around the same evening.
label: #bcbda9
note: A 28px edge, a lighter serif and open sans text create a little more air. The added space is systematic: it applies to the header, every card, and the opened listing.
spacing: 28px outer edges and card padding; the inner date-to-title gap remains 16px.

name: Field Notes
title: A touch more structure.
label: #b2c2ac
note: Literata and Plex give the family a slightly more practical voice. A greener charcoal and firmer small labels sharpen the information while preserving the same quiet hierarchy.
spacing: 24px edges, a 44px title line and a fixed 16px gap between the two fact columns.

name: Umber
title: A warmer reading surface.
label: #c2b6a3
note: The same layout shifts toward umber and mineral pink. Source Sans 3 uses a 16px reading size on the same 24px line; Lora receives a small weight increase to balance it.
spacing: 24px edges; larger reading text, with category and metadata sizes held steady.

name: Hushed
title: Less weight. A longer breath.
label: #b6bda8
note: The lightest title weight and a slightly larger detail title create the most spacious reading. Its near-neutral accent gives the photograph and the letterforms more presence.
spacing: 28px edges and card padding; 48px detail-title lines, with all practical facts on the shared grid.
